title: KeyValueEditor
description: Edits an ordered list of string pairs with multi-line keys and values, add and remove actions; rows are tracked by a stable id.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Controlled entries with custom labels; newlines and duplicate keys are preserved.

errors.title: Validation errors
errors.description: The consumer validates and passes errors by entry id; they stay attached across reordering.

KeyValueEditorProps.entries: Rows (controlled); omit for an uncontrolled editor
KeyValueEditorProps.defaultEntries: Initial rows of an uncontrolled editor
KeyValueEditorProps.onChange: Called with the next rows after an edit, an addition or a removal
KeyValueEditorProps.keyLabel: Label of the key fields (followed by the row number for screen readers)
KeyValueEditorProps.removeLabel: Accessible label of the remove buttons (followed by the row number)
KeyValueEditorProps.errors: Field errors by entry id; validation belongs to the consumer

KeyValueEntry.id: Stable id of the row (React key, error lookup); keep it across edits
KeyValueEntry.key: Key text (whitespace and newlines are preserved)
KeyValueEntry.value: Value text (whitespace and newlines are preserved)

KeyValueEntryErrors.key: Error message of the key field
KeyValueEntryErrors.value: Error message of the value field

cssVars.--key-value-editor-gap: Space between the rows and the add button
cssVars.--key-value-editor-column-gap: Space between the key, the value and the remove button of a row
cssVars.--key-value-editor-control-height: Size of the remove button and minimum height of the key field and of the add button (defaults to the density's small control height)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Initial rows from a JSON object in the value attribute, custom column labels; the value property (rows with stable ids) is shown after each minerva-change.

errors.title: Validation and errors
errors.description: Validation belongs to the page: errors (by row id) shows messages under empty or duplicate keys, and setCustomValidity() makes the element invalid in forms.

form.title: In a form
form.description: The rows are submitted under name as one JSON string; required blocks an editor without rows (remove the row to try it), and reset restores the rows of the value attribute.

props.defaultValue: Initial rows (the value attribute, JSON: an array of { key, value } or a { "key": "value" } object), restored by form.reset().
props.name: Name under which the rows are submitted, as a JSON array of { key, value }.
props.required: An editor without rows is invalid (valueMissing).
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: A row was committed (field blur), added or removed.
events.minerva-input: A key or value is being typed; detail: { value } (the entries).
events.minerva-change: A row was committed, added or removed; detail: { value } (the entries).

cssVars.--icon-button-color: Icon color of the inner icon buttons.
cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: Background of the inner icon buttons on hover.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of a pressed inner icon button.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-bg: Background of a pressed inner icon button.
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the inner icon buttons (defaults follow the density's control heights).
cssVars.--icon-button-icon-size: Font size of the icons of the inner icon buttons.
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the inner icon buttons (defaults to --radius-lg).

methods.focus: Focuses the first key field, else the add button.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
